subject: Multiple users on same app with long running processes

messages.author: fa4c68d8c5475b7e
messages.subject: Multiple users on same app with long running processes
parts:
Howdy-

I'm using the latest shiny-server and I have an app that does some expensive long running calculations (Value At Risk)

When user 1 is connected and kicks off a long running process (it's currently at 400+ seconds now) and another user in another browser comes along to access the same shiny app, the second user eventually times out and cannot access the app.

Is there any way to find out what is going on behind the scenes and figure out how I can structure my apps to not block in this manner?

Thanks,
CJ

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Multiple users on same app with long running processes
parts: The current version of shiny-server is limited to this model, where all users of a given app share the same process. The commercial version of shiny-server (beta coming this summer) will have additional deployment options, such as one-process-per-user; that should be what you want.
